subtopic: Impact of Ongoing Fees on Returns
source_evidence: even small ongoing fees can have a significant impact on your return on your investments over time.
answer: Ongoing fees can affect your investment returns over time, even when no transactions occur in your account. When comparing advisory accounts, ask how each fee is calculated and consider the total fees you may pay, including fees paid to your adviser and to third-party providers. Understanding these costs can help you assess how they may affect the returns on your investments.
